title: Machine learning identifies a microRNA signature of insulin transcription in human tissues
summary: Machine-learning workflows on 353 human tissue samples selected microRNAs associated with (pro-)insulin transcripts, using 30 islets and 62 insulin-negative tissues for discovery and 261 tissues (including nine type 2 diabetes islets) for validation. Eight top microRNAs, including miR-375-3p and miR-7-5p, were associated with and predictive of insulin transcript levels. Overexpression in duct cell lines and knockdown in islet cells supported their regulatory roles.
ai_technology: Machine-learning workflows selecting microRNAs associated with insulin transcripts
